cards.text: Moses is up on Mount Sinai, and the LORD has been laying out plans for the tabernacle: the ark, the altars, the oil, the incense. BIG plans. Now the LORD tells Moses He's picked someone to lead the work.

cards.question: Who has the LORD called by name to lead the building of the tabernacle?

cards.text: Bezalel is the son of Uri, the son of Hur, from the tribe of Judah. And God doesn't just pick this man and wish him luck.

cards.question: God fills Bezalel with skill, ability and knowledge in all kinds of craftsmanship. What else does God fill him with?

cards.text: Bezalel can design artistic works in gold, silver and bronze, so friend, this man is a whole workshop. I press dough, and I need my MUSTACHE to help me do it.

cards.question: Gold, silver and bronze are just the start. God's plan is for Bezalel to be a master of every craft.

cards.text: And Bezalel isn't working alone, either. I've got a planet full of cookie boxes and ONE mustache, so I'm a little jealous of what God gives him next.

cards.question: Who does God select to be Bezalel's assistant?
Bezalel is from the tribe of Judah, and his assistant Oholiab is from the tribe of ___.

cards.text: God has also given skill to all the craftsmen, so they can make the Tent of Meeting, the ark with the mercy seat on it, the table, the lampstand, both altars, the basin, the holy garments for the priests, the anointing oil and the incense. Every piece is to be made according to all God has commanded Moses.

Then the LORD gives Moses a message for the Israelites, and this one isn't about gold or wood, it's about a day OFF. Friend, in that junk drawer every day was a day off, and let me tell you, it was NOT relaxing.

cards.question: What does the LORD tell the Israelites they must surely keep?

cards.text: God calls the Sabbath a sign between Him and the Israelites, and He says, 'Keep the Sabbath, for it is holy to you.' And friend, He does not treat this one lightly.

cards.question: The LORD says the Sabbath will be a sign between Him and the Israelites for the generations to come. It's so they may know what?

answers.text: That He is the LORD who sanctifies them
That He is the LORD who feeds them
That He is the LORD who fights for them

cards.question: God says anyone who profanes the Sabbath must surely be put to death.
God says that for ___ days work may be done, but the ___ day is a Sabbath of complete rest, holy to the LORD.

cards.text: The Israelites must keep the Sabbath, celebrating it as a permanent covenant for the generations to come. Then God says why it's a sign forever.

cards.question: Why is the Sabbath a sign between God and the Israelites forever?

answers.text: The LORD made the heavens and the earth in six days and rested on the seventh
The LORD led Israel out of Egypt in six days and rested on the seventh
The LORD gave all of His laws in six days and rested on the seventh

cards.text: When the LORD has finished speaking with Moses on Mount Sinai, He gives Moses something. Friend, the last thing anybody handed ME was a one-way trip to the back of a junk drawer.

cards.question: What does the LORD give Moses on Mount Sinai?

answers.text: Two stone tablets written by God's finger
A scroll of the law written by Moses' hand
A gold plate engraved by Bezalel's hands

findings.problem: The opening card states facts from outside the passage without a reference. It says the LORD has already laid out plans for the ark, the altars, the oil and the incense, and that Moses is on Mount Sinai. Those plans come from Exodus 25-30, yet the card cites only Exodus 31:1-2.

rule.text: Facts from outside the passage are fine when they help, like who a new person is or who wrote a letter, with their reference.

findings.problem: This is the first time Moses appears in the lesson, but the card never says who he is.

rule.text: The first time someone shows up, he says simply who they are, like "Cyrus, king of Persia" or "Moses, Israel's leader."

findings.problem: The joke doesn't click. Bezalel works in many materials, but 'I press dough, and I need my MUSTACHE to help me do it' doesn't share that action, because the mustache is how Papa Dorin always works. The card also leans on the mustache for a laugh, and card 7 does the same, which turns the mustache into his main source of jokes.

rule.text: It clicks instantly for any adult, with no explaining.

findings.problem: This summary card for the list of tabernacle items in Exodus 31:7-11 names every item one by one instead of saying in a few words what the list covers.

rule.text: He says in a few words what it covers and doesn't go item by item.

findings.problem: Card 13 already tells Exodus 31:14 by quoting 'Keep the Sabbath, for it is holy to you.' Card 14 then goes back to ask about the purpose clause in Exodus 31:13, and card 15 returns to 31:14. The walkthrough steps backward through the passage.
findings.question: Must choice cards follow the verse order within a stop, or may a choice card go back to an earlier verse after a story card has moved ahead?

findings.problem: The card is almost word for word Exodus 31:16 followed by a plain lead-in, with none of Papa Dorin's voice.

rule.text: Short, but not stripped down. A story card still has enough of Papa Dorin's voice and enough context that the moment makes sense.

findings.problem: The joke contradicts his backstory. 'The last thing anybody handed ME was a one-way trip to the back of a junk drawer' ignores the angel's invitation, which came after the drawer. It also calls the drawer a one-way trip, when he was called out of it. Nobody handed him anything either: he was carried and slid into the drawer.

rule.text: His backstory, family, bakery and mission are the Dorinverse story in this file. He can talk about them freely, but never adds anything new to them.

findings.problem: Multiple choice dominates the stop. 7 of the 11 choice cards are multiple choice, against 2 true or false and 2 fill in the blank.

rule.text: No stop repeats another stop's pattern, and no type dominates a stop by a wide margin.
